definitions.explanation: The bony prominence in the upper part of the cheek, beneath the outer corner of the eye. Often referenced when describing facial features, anatomy, or the effects of aging or weight loss.

examples.japanese: {頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{張|は}った→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She has facial features with prominent cheekbones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痩|や}せた→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧せい⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Perhaps because he lost weight rapidly, his cheekbones now stand out more than before.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んだ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦{拍子|ひょうし}→拍子：10495_hyoushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有無|うむ}→有無：13019_umu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When I fell, I hit my cheekbone hard, so I went to the hospital to be checked for a fracture.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{頬|ほほ}→頬：00110_hoho⟧ ('cheek') + ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ ('bone'), with rendaku turning ほね into ぼね. The reading ほおぼね (with おお) is also acceptable and reflects the alternative pronunciation of ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧ for cheek.

USAGE:
- Used in everyday descriptions of faces, in beauty/cosmetics contexts, and in medical contexts (fractures, surgery, dental anesthesia).
- The medical/technical term is {頬骨|きょうこつ} (zygomatic bone), used in anatomy, surgery, and orthodontics. Both readings refer to the same bone, but ほほぼね is the colloquial term.
- Often appears in descriptions of facial structure: 'high cheekbones' is a feature commented on in modeling, fashion, and ethnographic descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have high cheekbones
- {頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: cheekbones to be prominent / to stick out
- {頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: cheekbones to protrude (often from weight loss)
- {頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hit one's cheekbone
- {頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧: cheekbone fracture
- {頬骨|ほほぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: cheekbones to stand out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頬|ほほ}→頬：00110_hoho⟧・⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧: cheek — the soft tissue of the cheek itself, not the underlying bone.
- {頬骨|きょうこつ}: zygomatic bone — the medical/anatomical reading of the same kanji compound.
- ⟦{顎|あご}→顎：04266_ago⟧: jaw; chin — the lower part of the face; sometimes confused in casual descriptions but anatomically distinct.
- ⟦こめかみ→こめかみ：05293_komekami⟧: temple — the side of the head between the eye and the ear; close to but separate from the cheekbone.
- ⟦えら→えら：28708_era⟧: jawline; angle of the jaw — the rear, lower part of the cheek/jaw, important when describing face shape.
